name: E-ZPass Virginia (VDOT) and Toll Roads in Virginia
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public ezpassva.com pages (home, About E-ZPass with funding, statements, closing and On-the-Go sections), the public MyAccount login page (Username + Password, reCAPTCHA) and the Toll Roads in Virginia Make a Payment page that ezpassva.com links for missed tolls and invoices (added to officialDomains). Automatic replenishment usually within 24 hours of reaching the low-balance threshold (typically $10 per transponder), $35 per transponder or average monthly use, whichever is higher; card, or ACH from checking/savings with a backup card. Manual payments online or by phone take debit, credit or prepaid cards only, so billing.methods is card; the fleet's AutoPay is limited to card as well because methods drives the saved methods (the real ACH option with a backup card is described in the AutoPay note and help). Statements free online; mailed statements $2.00/month per group of three transponders. Closing an account needs the Account Closure Form by mail, email or in person (cancel_service unsupported online, channel mail). Lost/stolen fee $10 standard, $20 Flex. On-the-Go transponder $35 at retail, all credited, $15 usable before registration. Reload Card retailer fee $1.50. Missed-toll administrative fees on tollroadsinvirginia.com vary by facility ($0 to $1.50) and are described in help only. No payment plan is described (payment_arrangement unsupported, inferred). Review 2026-10-10: contact.phone set to 1-877-762-7824 (the catalog list also carried the TTY relay line 800-828-1120 and a secondary number, which showed on the close-account page as numbers to call).

autopay.note: Automatic replenishment charges your card (or your checking or savings account, with a backup card) usually within 24 hours of the balance reaching the low-balance threshold, typically $10 per transponder.

paperless.note: Detailed monthly and quarterly statements are free online; a mailed statement costs $2.00 a month for each group of up to three transponders.

guest_pay.note: Toll invoices and violation notices, and unpaid trips before a bill arrives, can be paid online without an E-ZPass account.

cancel_service.note: Accounts are not closed online. Send the Account Closure Form by mail or email or bring it to a Customer Service Center, and return your transponders to avoid the lost/stolen fee ($10 standard, $20 Flex).

payment_arrangement.note: No payment plan is described online. Pay invoices and notices in full, or call E-ZPass Virginia at 1-877-762-7824 about a balance you cannot pay.

help.title: Fund your E-ZPass account
paragraphs: All transponders on an account share one prepaid balance. With automatic replenishment, the account is refilled usually within 24 hours after it reaches or falls below the low-balance threshold, which is typically $10.00 per transponder.

You can replenish from a credit or debit card, or by ACH from a checking or savings account as long as a valid card is on file as backup. The replenishment amount is $35 per transponder or your average monthly usage, whichever is higher: two light-use transponders refill with $70.00 when the balance reaches $20.00.

To replenish manually, pay online or by phone at 1-877-762-7824 with a debit, credit or prepaid card, use card, cash or check at a Customer Service Center, or load cash with an E-ZPass Reload Card at participating retailers (the retailer adds a $1.50 fee each time).

help.title: Account activity and statements
paragraphs: Log in to see toll transactions and payments and download account data. Detailed monthly and quarterly statements are free online.

A detailed statement by mail costs $2.00 per month for the first three transponders and another $2.00 for each additional group of up to three ($2.00 for 1-3, $4.00 for 4-6, $6.00 for 7-9). Sign up for email or text alerts when the balance gets low.

help.title: Closing your account
paragraphs: Complete the Account Closure Form and send it by mail or email, or bring it to a Customer Service Center.

Return each transponder at a Customer Service Center or by mail to E-ZPass Customer Service Center, PO Box 1234, Clifton Forge, VA 24422-1234, wrapped in foil or a mylar bag. Transponders not returned are charged the lost/stolen fee: $10 for a standard transponder, $20 for an E-ZPass Flex.

help.title: Missed tolls, invoices and violation notices
paragraphs: If you used a Virginia toll facility without paying, or received a toll invoice or violation notice, pay it online at Toll Roads in Virginia with Pay a Missed Toll or Pay an Invoice/Notice. You can pay a missed trip before an invoice is sent.

Some facilities add an administrative fee to missed tolls, for example $1.50 on the Coleman Bridge, I-64 Express, I-66 Inside the Beltway, Powhite Parkway and RMTA Expressway System, and none on the Dulles Toll Road. Privately operated facilities bill separately.

help.title: E-ZPass On-the-Go
paragraphs: An E-ZPass On-the-Go transponder costs $35 at participating retailers, and the whole $35 is credited to your account. Before you register it, only $15 can be used, and only on Virginia toll roads and Express Lanes.
Register it online by opening an account or adding it to your existing account; the rest of the balance is then available in Virginia right away and on other E-ZPass roads within 48 hours.

extra.intent: Using the E-ZPass VA website's help pages, find the monthly cost of a mailed statement for an account with one to three transponders. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: A mailed statement costs $2.00 per month for one to three transponders.

extra.intent: Using the E-ZPass VA website's help pages, find the lost/stolen fee for an E-ZPass Flex transponder. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: The lost/stolen fee for an E-ZPass Flex transponder is $20.
